item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 26/Jan/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An intense winter monsoon will affect the coastal areas of southern China in the next couple of days. The weather will be cold and very dry over the region. It will be very cold in the morning over inland areas. With the monsoon being replaced by an easterly airstream, it will become cloudier gradually with a few light rain patches over the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week. However, it will remain cool in the morning and at night. The easterly airstream will moderate over the weekend.

Date/Month: 27/01 (Monday)
Wind: North force 5, force 6 offshore at first, occasionally force 8 on high ground.
Weather: Cold in the morning and at night. Becoming fine and very dry.
Temp range: 10 - 16 C
R.H. range: 35 - 65 per Cent
PSR: Low
